options.A: To monitor response and recurrence, not to screen asymptomatic people

question: In CONKO-001, adjuvant gemcitabine changed median disease-free survival from:

options.A: 6.7 months with surgery alone to 13.4 months
options.E: The trial did not report disease-free survival

correctAnswerText: 6.7 months with surgery alone to 13.4 months
explanation: Median disease-free survival was 13.4 versus 6.7 months, with five-year survival 20.7% versus 10.4% [1].
sourceArticle: Review of pancreatic adenocarcinoma risk, diagnosis, treatment, and outcomes

question: In the metastatic trial cited, FOLFIRINOX versus gemcitabine gave median overall survival of:
explanation: Median overall survival was 11.1 months (95% CI 9.0–13.2) versus 6.8 months (5.5–7.6), HR 0.57 (95% CI 0.45–0.73) [1].
sourceArticle: Review of pancreatic adenocarcinoma risk, diagnosis, treatment, and outcomes
